title: ProjectE ECAD/MCAD thermal bridge report
description: Thermal contact analysis between a heat-source component and an enclosure heatsink boss, plus the geometry this tool can WRITE into a .kicad_pcb (a B.Mask opening polygon and an Edge.Cuts milling slot). This is the only ported tool that mutates a board file; it takes a .bak first, verifies the write, and rolls back on failure, and it is deliberately NOT published over MCP.

wrote.description: True only when --write was given AND the write survived verification. A rolled-back write reports false.

proposals.description: Geometry the tool would write: mask openings and milling slots. Present in dry-run too, so the caller can review before --write.

design.description: The board this report measured, with its digest. REQUIRED: an untieable report is SCREEN_ONLY however good the number in it is. sha256 is null when the path could not be read - loud, not absent.

metrics.description: check name -> violation count. Exists because `checks` is a list and the assertion selector grammar addresses a.b paths. A count of 0 is NOT a pass when scanned == 0; that distinction lives in `checks`.

$comment: No enclosure data means no thermal contact conclusion: the checks report NO_COVERAGE rather than 'no problem found'. The milling-slot suggestion is withheld entirely when the remaining web would drop below the mechanical minimum - trading vibration/solder-crack margin for thermal isolation is never done silently.
